2609.11687.title: Structured Transforms for Low-Overhead Quantization of Language Models
2609.11687.paper_summary: We revisit Kashin-decomposition-based weight quantization for large language models and propose an improved algorithm with stronger convergence properties and structured, efficient orthogonal transforms. The method retains the core factorization of each weight into two components -- one with bounded infinity norm and the other with bounded infinity norm after an orthogonal transformation -- but replaces the dense random orthogonal matrix with a sign-randomized Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), reducing the per-iteration cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$. The proposed greedy algorithm with alternating updates guarantees the four-peak distribution required for stable 2-bit clustering of each factor and admits closed-form initialization of cluster centers, removing the multi-restart k-means bottleneck of prior work. Composed with OPTQ-style sequential error compensation and QuIP-style incoherence preprocessing, the resulting JAX pipeline is competitive with OPTQ, QuIP, QuIP-RG and a fine-tuning- and vector-quantization-free variant of QuIP# at 4-bit per channel on OPT, Llama-2 and Pythia, with favorable wall-clock scaling. The bounded-$\ell_\infty$ factorization is also notably robust: on stress configurations where QuIP variants diverge to four-digit perplexity (Pythia-6.9B) or abort with NaNs in LDL back-substitution (Mistral-7B), Kashin-DCT remains numerically stable and stays close to FP16 baseline. At inference time, each weight decomposes into two 2-bit factor codes per channel that are structurally suited to native-2-bit hardware.
2609.11687.paper_summary_zh: 我們重新探討基於Kashin分解的權重量化方法，並提出一種改進的演算法，具有更強的收斂性和結構化、高效的正交變換。該方法保留了每個權重的核心分解為兩個組件——一個具有有界的無窮範數，另一個在正交變換後也具有有界的無窮範數——但用符號隨機化的離散餘弦變換（DCT）替換了稠密的隨機正交矩陣，將每次迭代的成本從 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ 降低到 $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$。所提出的貪婪演算法具有交替更新的特性，保證了穩定的2位聚類所需的四峰分佈，並允許集群中心的封閉形式初始化，消除了先前工作的多重重啟k-means瓶頸。結合OPTQ風格的序列誤差補償和QuIP風格的非一致性預處理，所得到的JAX管道在OPT、Llama-2和Pythia上以每通道4位的精度與OPTQ、QuIP、QuIP-RG及一種無需微調和向量量化的QuIP#變體競爭，並具有良好的牆鐘縮放性能。有限的-$\ell_\infty$分解在壓力配置下也顯得特別穩健：在QuIP變體發散至四位數困惑度（Pythia-6.9B）或在LDL反向替代中因NaN而中止（Mistral-7B）時，Kashin-DCT保持數值穩定，並接近FP16基準。在推理時，每個權重分解為每通道兩個結構上適合於原生2位硬體的因子碼。
